steps.text: File:Bank_icon.png Bank at Varrock west bank. — Withdraw: All keys, all runes, wine (optional). — {{Inventory |Chronicle |Silverlight key (Wizard Traiborn) |Silverlight key (Captain Rovin) |Silverlight key (Sir Prysin) |Water rune\40 |Mind rune\15 |Air rune\25 | |Jug of wine |Jug of wine | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | }}

steps.title: Talk to Romeo to watch the …
steps.text: Talk to Romeo to watch the cutscene

steps.title: Talk to Sir Prysin to get …
steps.text: Talk to Sir Prysin to get the Silverlight. — File:Chronicle.png Chronicle teleport as soon as the sword is automatically equipped

steps.title: Go into the Wizards' circle and …
steps.text: Go into the Wizards' circle and beat Delrith. — Enter from the south and stay behind the middle southern pillar. — Manually cast Water Strike on Delrith with Silverlight equipped. — Always step back behind the pillar after casting so the Dark wizards do not attack you. — If a Dark wizard is attacking you, walk a few tiles away from the pillar to exit the cutscene and re-enter.

steps.title: Enter the Champions' Guild to complete …
steps.text: Enter the Champions' Guild to complete the run!
